question: Nrityabharati Kathak Dance Academy in Pune was established by which of the following Sangeet Natak Akademi Awardees?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohini Bhate**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Nrityabharati Kathak Dance Academy** was** founded by Kathak dancer Rohini Bhate in 1947. **
 
• **Rohini Bhate** was a Bharatnatyam and Kathak dancer. She was born in Patna and went to school in Pune .
 
• She advised Khairagarh University and Lalit Kala Kendra, University of Pune, on the teaching of kathak and other dance forms.
 
• **She received the Kalidas Samman **in **2001, ****the Maharashtra Rajya Puraskar in 1977**, and the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1979**, and **the Maharashtra Gaurav Puraskar in 1990.**
 
• **She became a Fellow of the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2006** and** received the Akademi Ratna Award in 2007.**
